query: How many days of annual leave do I get each year?
reference_summary: Full-time employees accrue 20 days of annual leave per year.

query: How far ahead do I need to ask for annual leave?
reference_summary: Leave requests should be submitted at least 14 days before the start date.

query: I will be off sick for a week, do I need paperwork?
reference_summary: A medical certificate is required for absences of more than 3 consecutive days.

query: How much parental leave can I take?
reference_summary: Eligible employees may take up to 26 weeks of paid parental leave.

query: My leave starts Monday and my request still shows as pending.
reference_summary: Ask the HR service desk to confirm the pending request before the leave starts.

query: I have worked here 12 years, how many annual leave days do I get?
reference_summary: Employees with 10 or more years of service accrue 25 days of annual leave per year.

query: My manager keeps shouting at me and mocking my accent. I want to make a formal complaint.
reference_summary: Raise the complaint with Employee Relations, which will acknowledge it within 2 working days.

query: A coworker touched me inappropriately yesterday and I do not feel safe coming in.
reference_summary: Contact Employee Relations today; the complaint will be acknowledged within 2 working days.

query: I think I was passed over for a role unfairly. How do I complain?
reference_summary: Raise the complaint with Employee Relations, which will acknowledge it within 2 working days.

query: Can I bring someone with me to a complaint meeting?
reference_summary: Complainants may bring a support person to any meeting.

query: There is a live wire hanging down near the loading dock.
reference_summary: Phone Health and Safety immediately, then submit a written hazard report within 24 hours.

query: The stairwell floor is flooded and someone has already slipped.
reference_summary: Phone Health and Safety immediately, then submit a written hazard report within 24 hours.

query: I nearly tripped on a loose cable yesterday. How do I report a near miss?
reference_summary: Report near misses within 5 working days using the hazard report form.

query: Where do I report a flickering light in the corridor?
reference_summary: Report it using the hazard report form.

query: I want to hire a new analyst. What do I need to do?
reference_summary: Get department head approval and submit a request with a position description to Recruitment, which will respond within 5 working days.

query: Do fixed-term roles need extra approval?
reference_summary: Fixed-term roles of more than 12 months require finance approval before advertising.

query: Our only payroll officer resigned today and we need cover by Monday.
reference_summary: Contact Recruitment today to discuss urgent cover; the request still needs department head approval.

query: I need to hire someone.
reference_summary: Ask which role is needed and whether it is fixed-term or permanent.

query: Hi, quick question.
reference_summary: Ask what the question is about.

query: Can you recommend a good lunch place near the office?
reference_summary: This is outside HR; ask whether there is an HR question to help with.

query: Can I carry over unused annual leave to next year, and how many days?
reference_summary: The supplied policy does not cover carry-over, so refer this to an HR advisor.

query: How long does visa sponsorship take for a new hire?
reference_summary: The supplied policy does not cover visa sponsorship, so refer this to Recruitment.

query: How many fire wardens does each floor need?
reference_summary: The supplied policy does not cover fire warden numbers, so refer this to Health and Safety.

query: I want to complain.
reference_summary: Ask what the complaint is about and whether anyone is at risk.
